panels.title: Requests running
panels.description: minisgl_running_requests gauge — in-flight decode batch.

panels.title: Requests waiting (queue)
panels.description: minisgl_waiting_requests gauge — queued, not yet scheduled.

panels.title: Decode speed (tok/s)
panels.description: Live per-stream decode rate = generation tok/s divided by concurrent running requests. Updates every scrape during in-flight generation (unlike the TPOT histogram, which only records on request completion). For batch this is the mean per-stream speed; see "Token throughput" for aggregate idle-inclusive throughput and the TPOT latency panel for per-completed-request tail latency.

panels.title: Prompt tok/s
panels.description: rate(minisgl_prompt_tokens_total) — prefill throughput.

panels.title: KV-pool utilization
panels.description: used/total KV-cache token slots.

panels.title: GDN-state utilization
panels.description: used/total GDN recurrent-state slots (hybrid models).

panels.title: Mean accept-len (tok/step)
panels.description: accepted/steps = minisgl_spec_accepted_tokens_total / minisgl_spec_steps_total. Headline lever for DFlash/DDTree speed. (No +1 bonus term — matches the repo's accept-len convention where 0.26 / 1.30 / 2.15 are reported.)

panels.title: Draft acceptance rate
panels.description: accepted/drafted = minisgl_spec_accepted_tokens_total / minisgl_spec_draft_tokens_total.

panels.title: Drafted tok/s
panels.description: rate(minisgl_spec_draft_tokens_total) — draft tokens proposed.

panels.title: Accepted tok/s
panels.description: rate(minisgl_spec_accepted_tokens_total) — draft tokens verified & kept.

panels.title: Mean accept-len over time
panels.description: accepted/steps over time — watch DFlash/DDTree tuning move this.

panels.title: Draft acceptance rate over time
panels.description: accepted/drafted fraction over time.

panels.title: Token throughput (incl. prefix cache)
panels.description: Idle-INCLUSIVE throughput: rate() over the window averages in the gaps between requests, so a bursty workload reads well below the decode speed. See "Decode speed" for model tok/s.

panels.title: Requests running / waiting
panels.description: batch occupancy vs queue depth.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: req/s: total arrived, succeeded, aborted (minisgl_requests_total / _success_total / _aborted_total).

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: aborted / (success + aborted), clamp_min guards divide-by-zero.

panels.title: Time to first token (TTFT)
panels.description: minisgl_ttft_seconds histogram.

panels.title: Time per output token (TPOT)
panels.description: minisgl_tpot_seconds histogram (inter-token latency).

panels.title: End-to-end request latency
panels.description: minisgl_request_latency_seconds histogram.

panels.title: KV-pool utilization %
panels.description: used/total KV token slots over time.

panels.title: GDN-state slot utilization %
panels.description: used/total GDN recurrent-state slots over time.
Windowed: cached / total prompt tokens = fraction of prefill skipped. ~0 when caching is off (naive).
panels.title: Hit ratio (windowed)

panels.description: Prompt tokens/s served from the prefix cache (not re-prefilled).
panels.title: Cached tok/s (saved)

panels.description: Prompt tokens/s actually run through prefill (cache misses).
panels.title: Prefill computed tok/s

panels.description: TRUE prefill throughput: computed prefill tokens / wall-seconds of prefill compute. Unlike 'Prompt tok/s' (prompt-token ARRIVAL rate), this measures the prefill kernel itself — the apples-to-apples analog of vLLM request_prompt_tokens_sum / request_prefill_time_seconds_sum.
panels.title: Prefill throughput (compute) tok/s

panels.description: Lifetime cached/total prompt tokens (minisgl_prefix_cache_hit_ratio).
panels.title: Hit ratio (cumulative)

panels.description: cached / total prompt tokens, windowed.
panels.title: Prefix cache hit ratio over time

panels.description: Stacked prompt-token throughput: cache-saved vs actually computed. Total height = prompt tok/s.
panels.title: Prefill tokens: cached vs computed
GPU memory bandwidth (GB/s, effective)
panels.description: Effective GDDR6 bandwidth = UMC (memory-controller) activity x peak. Peak = mem_clock_MHz x 0.512e9 B/s (256-bit bus, GDDR6 16n prefetch: 640 GB/s @ ~1250 MHz, auto-tracks the memory OC). Dashed line = peak at the current clock.

panels.title: GPU memory-controller activity (UMC %)
panels.description: amdgpu_umc_activity_percent — measured fraction of time the memory controller is busy (the directly-reported BW-utilization signal the GB/s panel is derived from).

panels.description: minisgl_cam_facts — subject→object edits across all namespaces.

panels.title: Facts evicted
panels.description: minisgl_cam_evicted — LRU-evicted under capacity pressure (0 = uncapped).
